methodology: Directly consulted Italian national immaterial-heritage summaries, SIUSA institutional archive abstracts, Umbria Tourism, and the Salemi local ritual-bread museum and civic Pro Loco. Each line-located short original paraphrase tracks specific region, feast, era, and source type. Do not treat multi-language translations on museum webpage as more sources. Different acts nested in one festival are not distinct Catholic customs; folk magical efficacy descriptions are strictly historical, not endorsed. SIUSA is a narrative archivist abstract rather than direct inspection of the 1851 or 1891 statutes. Same locality/author source reuse possible. Full original manuscripts not inspected; rites not checked for 1962 correctness.
